phase_help.alignment: Registering all frames of a series onto a common pixel grid so each star keeps the same coordinates throughout the night.
phase_help.calibration: Removing the camera signature from raw frames with master darks and flats, plus sanity gates that catch a wrong or stale master.
phase_help.comp_selection: Choosing the ensemble of constant stars for differential photometry from the MASTERSTAR pool: colour class first, then stability (LOO RMS), then distance; isolation, saturation and frame coverage are gates.
phase_help.detection: Finding stars, plate solving and the MASTERSTAR reference catalog matched to Gaia.
phase_help.export: TESS check of new variability candidates.
phase_help.extinction: Correcting for the atmosphere: second-order extinction (k2) that depends on star color and airmass, and optional color-term handling.
phase_help.observer: Your name and AAVSO identity for reports and exports. The observing site is the default LOCATION row in Database Explorer.
phase_help.paths: Where VYVAR keeps its data: the archive, the calibration library, the app database and the star catalogs. Set once after installing.
phase_help.photometry: Measuring star brightness: aperture and sky annulus, error model, light-curve outlier flags, neighbour light and the ePSF product.
phase_help.qc: Per-frame quality checks (sharpness, elongation, background, star count) and the sky-surface preprocess.
phase_help.reports: The PDF report: the HR diagram of the field and its optional online lookups (Gaia archive, SIMBAD).
phase_help.system: Machine-level behaviour: memory kept free when VYVAR sizes its parallel workers.
phase_help.trust: How VYVAR grades its own results: green / yellow / red trust from the comparison ensemble and the check star, and light-curve quality limits.

aavso_filter_map.help: Optional translation of your filter names to AAVSO filter codes for the exports (for example NoFilter -> CV). Empty = filter names are used as they are.
aavso_filter_map.label: AAVSO filter names

alignment_max_control_points.help: Most star pairs used to fit one frame onto the reference; more is more robust but slower.
alignment_max_control_points.label: Alignment control points

alignment_max_stars.help: Number of brightest stars the frame alignment matches.
alignment_max_stars.label: Stars used for alignment

annulus_inner_fwhm.help: Inner radius of the sky ring around each star.
annulus_inner_fwhm.label: Sky annulus inner radius

annulus_outer_fwhm.help: Outer radius of the sky ring around each star; must be larger than the inner radius.
annulus_outer_fwhm.label: Sky annulus outer radius

aperture_fwhm_factor.help: Base aperture radius in FWHM, the same for every star of a frame.
aperture_fwhm_factor.label: Aperture radius

apply_color_term.help: auto: apply the colour term when it is measured well; on: always; off: keep the instrumental system.
apply_color_term.label: Colour term

archive_root.help: Folder of the observation archive (raw and processed drafts).
archive_root.label: Archive

auto_fwhm_enabled.help: Set the FWHM limit for bad frames from the seeing of the night itself instead of a fixed number.
auto_fwhm_enabled.label: Night FWHM limit from the data

auto_fwhm_k_factor.help: Frames with FWHM above median + k x robust sigma of the night are marked as bad seeing.
auto_fwhm_k_factor.label: Night FWHM limit k

calibration_library_root.help: Folder of the master darks and flats (by camera, binning and temperature).
calibration_library_root.label: Calibration library

calibration_master_ccd_temp_tolerance_c.help: Largest difference of sensor temperature between a master dark and the light frames it may calibrate.
calibration_master_ccd_temp_tolerance_c.label: Dark temperature tolerance

check_select_rms_floor.help: Smallest scatter used when choosing the check star.
check_select_rms_floor.label: Check star scatter floor

check_star_min_epochs.help: Fewest points the check star must have for its verdict to count.
check_star_min_epochs.label: Check star minimum points

comp_color_tiers.help: Colour classes 1-3: largest |BP-RP| difference between comparison star and target. Selection takes the first class with enough comparison stars and orders them by scatter, colour and distance.
comp_color_tiers.label: Colour classes

comp_contamination_penalty_k.help: How strongly contaminated comparison stars lose weight in the ensemble.
comp_contamination_penalty_k.label: Contamination weight penalty

comp_max_delta_bprp.help: Colour limit after classes 1-3. Wider only for very red targets when too few comparison stars exist.
comp_max_delta_bprp.label: Largest colour difference

comp_max_slope_mmag_hr.help: Comparison stars drifting faster than this are rejected.
comp_max_slope_mmag_hr.label: Comparison drift limit

comp_pool_derived_admission.help: On: only known variables (VSX, Gaia) are removed from the comparison pool; scatter, colour and distance enter as weights.
comp_pool_derived_admission.label: Drop only known variables

comp_select_rms_floor.help: Smallest scatter used in the ensemble weights (avoids division by near zero).
comp_select_rms_floor.label: Comparison scatter floor

comp_slope_significance_k.help: A comparison star's trend counts as real drift only above this significance.
comp_slope_significance_k.label: Comparison drift significance

comp_catalog_offset_max_mag.help: Exclude a comparison star whose catalogue minus measured magnitude differs from the other comparison stars by more than this (replaced from the reserve); 0 = off.
comp_catalog_offset_max_mag.label: Comparison catalogue offset limit

comp_trust_min_comps.help: Fewest comparison stars for green trust; fewer give yellow, never red.
comp_trust_min_comps.label: Comparison stars for green

comparison_stars_pool_n.help: Most candidate comparison stars in the pool; 0 = no limit.
comparison_stars_pool_n.label: Comparison pool size

dao_centroid_max_shift_fwhm.help: When a detected centroid lies farther than this from the catalogue position, the catalogue position is used.
dao_centroid_max_shift_fwhm.label: Centroid shift limit

database_path.help: The VYVAR SQLite database (drafts, equipment, telescopes, locations, results).
database_path.label: App database

detection_threshold_sigma.help: Detection limit of every star finder in VYVAR (quality check, alignment, plate solving, MASTERSTAR, per-frame catalogs), in sky sigmas.
detection_threshold_sigma.label: Star detection threshold

epsf_auto_run.help: On: the night run and RUN VYVAR also run the ePSF stage for the ePSF targets. Off: run it from the ePSF tab. Exports to AAVSO and VarAstro stay aperture photometry.
epsf_auto_run.label: Run ePSF in every night run (beta)

epsf_targets.help: Which targets ePSF measures: ALL, or VSX types, star names or catalogue ids separated by commas; * is a wildcard (for example EA, EB, EW or E*).
epsf_targets.label: ePSF targets

epsf_export_auto.help: Write the ePSF light-curve text files (BJD, delta mag, error) when an ePSF run finishes. For your own use, not an AAVSO submission.
epsf_export_auto.label: Write ePSF light-curve files

epsf_min_stars.help: Fewest suitable MASTERSTAR stars needed to build the ePSF; below it the ePSF run stops.
epsf_min_stars.label: ePSF minimum stars

err_empty_apertures_min.help: Fewest valid empty-sky apertures for the background noise measurement of a frame.
err_empty_apertures_min.label: Empty apertures needed

err_empty_apertures_n.help: Number of empty-sky apertures placed per frame to measure the background noise.
err_empty_apertures_n.label: Empty apertures per frame

exoplanet_match_max_sep_arcsec.help: Largest distance between a detected star and a known exoplanet host to label it (label only).
exoplanet_match_max_sep_arcsec.label: Exoplanet host match radius

forced_photometry_enabled.help: Measure MASTERSTAR stars at their known positions also in frames where the star finder missed them.
forced_photometry_enabled.label: Forced photometry

forced_photometry_margin_px.help: Extra margin from the frame edge for forced measurements.
forced_photometry_margin_px.label: Forced photometry edge margin

frame_height_px.help: Frame height in pixels; measured from FITS NAXIS2 at run time. WAVE-B internalized it (no longer stored in config.json).
frame_height_px.label: Frame Height PX

frame_width_px.help: Frame width in pixels; measured from FITS NAXIS1 at run time. WAVE-B internalized it (no longer stored in config.json).
frame_width_px.label: Frame Width PX

gaia_db_path.help: The local Gaia DR3 SQLite catalog: positions, magnitudes and colours for star identification, comparison stars and plate solving.
gaia_db_path.label: Gaia DR3 catalog

gain.help: Native-domain detector gain (e-/ADU_native). Science photon/SNR terms use container-domain gain via gain_photon_transfer (g_pt or gain/gain_container_scale); never bare DB gain on container ADU (WIDE-ERR-03).
gain.label: Gain

gs11_dilution_aperture_arcsec.help: Aperture for the neighbour light estimate; 0 = the photometric aperture.
gs11_dilution_aperture_arcsec.label: Neighbour light aperture

gs11_dilution_enabled.help: Estimate from Gaia how much light of neighbouring stars falls into each aperture.
gs11_dilution_enabled.label: Neighbour light estimate

gs11_dilution_mag_limit_delta.help: Neighbours up to this many magnitudes fainter than the star are counted.
gs11_dilution_mag_limit_delta.label: Neighbour light depth

gs11_target_min_dilution.help: Targets whose own light is below this fraction of the aperture light are flagged as blended.
gs11_target_min_dilution.label: Blended target limit

hrd_dsc_confirm_prob.help: Gaia classifier probability needed to confirm a class in the HR diagram.
hrd_dsc_confirm_prob.label: HRD class probability

hrd_enrich_max_candidates.help: Most stars looked up online per report.
hrd_enrich_max_candidates.label: HRD online lookups

hrd_enrich_tap_timeout_s.help: Time limit of one online query.
hrd_enrich_tap_timeout_s.label: HRD lookup timeout

hrd_max_per_category.help: Most highlighted stars per category in the HR diagram.
hrd_max_per_category.label: HRD highlights per category

hrd_min_per_net.help: Fewest highlighted stars kept from each search method.
hrd_min_per_net.label: HRD highlights per search

hrd_nss_category_enabled.help: Add Gaia non-single stars (binaries) as a highlight category.
hrd_nss_category_enabled.label: HRD binaries category

hrd_online_enrich_enabled.help: Look up details of highlighted stars in the Gaia archive (needs internet).
hrd_online_enrich_enabled.label: HRD online details

hrd_parallax_min_mas.help: Smallest parallax for placing a star in the absolute-magnitude HR diagram.
hrd_parallax_min_mas.label: HRD minimum parallax

hrd_parallax_snr_min.help: Smallest parallax SNR for a reliable HR diagram position.
hrd_parallax_snr_min.label: HRD parallax SNR

hrd_simbad_enrich_enabled.help: Look up SIMBAD object types of highlighted stars (needs internet).
hrd_simbad_enrich_enabled.label: HRD SIMBAD types

k2_defaults_bprp.help: Optional own k2 values per band (BP-RP units); empty = the built-in literature values.
k2_defaults_bprp.label: Own k2 per band

k2_mode.help: literature: band-dependent k2 values from the literature (BP-RP units); off: no second-order extinction.
k2_mode.label: Second-order extinction

lc_quality_min_frames.help: Fewest frames for a full light-curve quality verdict.
lc_quality_min_frames.label: Light curve minimum frames

lc_quality_min_normal_frac.help: Smallest fraction of unflagged points a light curve needs.
lc_quality_min_normal_frac.label: Light curve normal points

lc_quality_short_min_frames.help: Fewest frames for the quality verdict of a short series; at most the light curve minimum.
lc_quality_short_min_frames.label: Short series minimum frames

astrometry_index_dir.help: Folder of the blind plate-solving index (catalogs/build_astro_index.py). Empty = vyvar_astro_index next to the Gaia catalog. Used only when a frame has no position in its header.
astrometry_index_dir.label: Blind plate-solve index

masterdark_validity_days.help: Age after which a master dark counts as old and VYVAR asks for new darks.
masterdark_validity_days.label: Master dark valid for

masterflat_validity_days.help: Age after which a master flat counts as old and VYVAR asks for new flats.
masterflat_validity_days.label: Master flat valid for

masterstar_best_of_n.help: How many of the best frames are tried as the MASTERSTAR reference when the first choice fails.
masterstar_best_of_n.label: MASTERSTAR candidates

masterstar_dao_pass2_sigma.help: Detection sigma of the second, deeper DAO pass on the masterstar stack.
masterstar_dao_pass2_sigma.label: Masterstar DAO Pass2 Sigma

masterstar_dao_centroid_qa_cap_px.help: Upper cap [px] when deriving pass2/seed centroid tolerances from astrometric residual p95.
masterstar_dao_centroid_qa_cap_px.label: Masterstar DAO Centroid QA Cap PX

masterstar_dao_centroid_qa_floor_px.help: Lower floor [px] when deriving pass2/seed centroid tolerances from astrometric residual p95.
masterstar_dao_centroid_qa_floor_px.label: Masterstar DAO Centroid QA Floor PX

masterstar_dao_empty_sky_false_accept_ma.help: Empty-sky audit (INV-DET/SEED-FALSEFILL-01): maximum pure-noise false-accept rate at MASTERSTAR build, measured on the image mirrored about its background (2*B - data).
masterstar_dao_empty_sky_false_accept_ma.label: Masterstar DAO Empty Sky False Accept Max

masterstar_dao_empty_sky_target_n.help: Empty-sky audit sample size (main-field positions) for false-fill rate measurement.
masterstar_dao_empty_sky_target_n.label: Masterstar DAO Empty Sky Target N

masterstar_dao_match_radius_k.help: Gaia match radius multiplier k times astrometric residual p95 [px] (DAO-GAIA-ERA-01).
masterstar_dao_match_radius_k.label: Masterstar DAO Match Radius K

masterstar_dao_pass1_dedup_px.help: Pass1 spatial deduplication radius [px] before pass2 targeted cutouts.
masterstar_dao_pass1_dedup_px.label: Masterstar DAO Pass1 Dedup PX

masterstar_dao_pass2_center_tol_px.help: Maximum centroid offset [px] for pass2 cutout acceptance at Gaia seed positions.
masterstar_dao_pass2_center_tol_px.label: Masterstar DAO Pass2 Center Tol PX

masterstar_forced_seed_centroid_max_px.help: FORCED_SEED admission: max COM centroid offset from propagated Gaia [px].
masterstar_forced_seed_centroid_max_px.label: Masterstar Forced Seed Centroid Max PX

masterstar_forced_seed_comp_pool_enabled.help: Admit FORCED_SEED stars into the comp/CT pool (default off).
masterstar_forced_seed_comp_pool_enabled.label: Masterstar Forced Seed Comp Pool Enabled

masterstar_forced_seed_snr_min.help: FORCED_SEED admission: minimum aperture SNR on local annulus background.
masterstar_forced_seed_snr_min.label: Masterstar Forced Seed SNR Min

masterstar_gaia_census_edge_margin_px.help: Gaia-complete census: edge margin [px] for EDGE source_state classification.
masterstar_gaia_census_edge_margin_px.label: Masterstar Gaia Census Edge Margin PX

masterstar_lock_leftover_radius_px.help: FORCED_SEED / leftover promotion: greedy match radius for leftover detections to Gaia [px].
masterstar_lock_leftover_radius_px.label: Masterstar Lock Leftover Radius PX

masterstar_lock_pair_tol_px.help: Lock-existing assignment: max shift from locked catalog_id xy to detection [px].
masterstar_lock_pair_tol_px.label: Masterstar Lock Pair Tol PX

masterstar_use_best_frame_fwhm.help: Uses the best frame's FWHM for masterstar detection kernels instead of an average.
masterstar_use_best_frame_fwhm.label: Masterstar Use Best Frame FWHM

objects_db_path.help: The local objects catalog: AAVSO VSX variable stars and NASA Exoplanet Archive hosts, built by catalogs/objects_make.py.
objects_db_path.label: Objects catalog (VSX + exoplanets)

observer_alt_m.help: Altitude of the observing site above sea level in meters; part of the site definition used for airmass and time corrections. WAVE-B removed the config.json copy - hydrated from the LOCATION row.
observer_alt_m.label: Observer Alt M

observer_code.help: Your official AAVSO observer code, written into every AAVSO export as #OBSCODE. A warning is shown while it is empty.
observer_code.label: AAVSO observer code

observer_lat.help: Latitude of the observing site in degrees. Hydrated from the draft's LOCATION record; WAVE-B removed the config.json copy.
observer_lat.label: Observer Lat

observer_location_id.help: Not stored in config.json: the default site is the LOCATION row with IS_DEFAULT (Database Explorer); a run may choose another site on the import page or with --location-id.
observer_location_id.label: Observing site (run time)

observer_location_name.help: Human-readable name of the selected observing site (e.g. Jirny, Dablice). WAVE-B removed the config.json copy - hydrated from the LOCATION row.
observer_location_name.label: Observer Location Name

observer_lon.help: Longitude of the observing site in degrees; hydrated from the LOCATION row (WAVE-B removed the config.json copy).
observer_lon.label: Observer Lon

observer_name.help: Your full name, printed in reports and exports.
observer_name.label: Observer name

osc_channel_binning.help: Colour (OSC) cameras only: N x N binning of each colour channel after the Bayer split. The total scale against the raw mosaic is 2 x N.
osc_channel_binning.label: OSC channel binning

per_frame_mp_reserve_ram_gb.help: Memory left free per parallel worker when VYVAR sizes the number of workers.
per_frame_mp_reserve_ram_gb.label: RAM kept free per worker

per_frame_sat_min_clean_frac.help: A target is measured only when at least this fraction of its frames is unsaturated.
per_frame_sat_min_clean_frac.label: Unsaturated frames needed

phase01_chip_interior_margin_px.help: Stars closer than this to the chip edge are not used as comparison stars.
phase01_chip_interior_margin_px.label: Chip edge margin

phase01_comparison_isolation_radius_px.help: Radius for the contamination index (light of neighbours within it against the star's own light); used to choose the check star.
phase01_comparison_isolation_radius_px.label: Contamination radius

phase01_comparison_max_comp_rms.help: Upper limit of a comparison star's leave-one-out scatter; the limit used is the smaller of this and k x photon noise.
phase01_comparison_max_comp_rms.label: Comparison scatter limit

comp_rms_loo_photon_k.help: A comparison star may scatter at most k times its photon noise.
comp_rms_loo_photon_k.label: Comparison scatter vs photon noise

phase01_comparison_min_dist_arcsec.help: Comparison stars closer to the target than this are not used.
phase01_comparison_min_dist_arcsec.label: Comparison minimum distance

phase01_comparison_min_frames_frac.help: Fraction of the frames a comparison star must be measured on.
phase01_comparison_min_frames_frac.label: Comparison frame coverage

phase01_comparison_n_comp_max.help: Largest comparison ensemble; the gain from more stars levels off around 6-8.
phase01_comparison_n_comp_max.label: Most comparison stars

phase01_comparison_n_comp_min.help: Comparison stars wanted per target; the colour classes widen until this many are found.
phase01_comparison_n_comp_min.label: Fewest comparison stars

phase01_ct_extrapolation_tol.help: How far beyond the colour range of the comparison stars the colour term may be used; 0 = not at all.
phase01_ct_extrapolation_tol.label: Colour term extrapolation

phase01_ct_min_comp.help: Fewest comparison stars needed to fit a colour term.
phase01_ct_min_comp.label: Colour term minimum stars

phase01_plate_scale_arcsec_per_px.help: Phase-1 plate scale; resolved from the WCS solution at run time. WAVE-B removed its config.json fallback - the resolver is authoritative.
phase01_plate_scale_arcsec_per_px.label: Phase01 Plate Scale Arcsec Per PX

lc_outlier_enabled.help: Flag single light-curve points that jump away from their neighbours and have evidence in the image. Points are flagged, never deleted.
lc_outlier_enabled.label: Flag isolated outliers

lc_outlier_n_sigma.help: A single point this far from the running median of its light curve is a candidate outlier.
lc_outlier_n_sigma.label: Outlier threshold

lc_outlier_adjacent_sigma.help: When the neighbouring point deviates the same way by this much, both stay normal (flares and eclipses are kept).
lc_outlier_adjacent_sigma.label: Outlier neighbour protection

lc_outlier_frame_qc_n_sigma.help: A frame is flagged when its FWHM, elongation, sky level or ensemble zero point is this many robust sigmas from the night median.
lc_outlier_frame_qc_n_sigma.label: Bad-frame threshold

lc_outlier_evidence_n_sigma.help: How unusual the star must look in that frame (centroid, shape, peak, sky, ePSF fit) against similar stars before the point is flagged.
lc_outlier_evidence_n_sigma.label: Outlier image evidence

plate_scale_arcsec_per_px.help: Global plate scale (arcsec/px); resolved from the WCS at run time - the number that converts pixels to sky angles. WAVE-B removed its config.json fallback.
plate_scale_arcsec_per_px.label: Plate Scale Arcsec Per PX

plate_solve_fov_deg.help: Field-of-view estimate (degrees) fed to the plate solver; computed from frame size and optics.
plate_solve_fov_deg.label: Plate Solve FOV Deg

preprocess_sky_surface_force_reapply.help: Recovery only: subtract the sky surface again even when the frame is already marked as done. Leave off.
preprocess_sky_surface_force_reapply.label: Re-subtract sky surface

preprocess_sky_surface_order.help: Order of the smooth sky surface subtracted before photometry: 0 = constant, 1 = plane, 2 = gentle 2D gradient.
preprocess_sky_surface_order.label: Sky background surface order

project_root.help: VYVAR installation root; derived from the code location, never edit.
project_root.label: Project Root

qc_after_calibrate_enabled.help: Measure per-frame quality (FWHM, elongation, sky, star count) right after calibration.
qc_after_calibrate_enabled.label: Quality check after calibration

qc_preprocess_workers.help: Number of parallel preprocessing workers; computed from CPU/RAM at startup, overridable by the VYVAR_PARALLEL_WORKERS environment variable.
qc_preprocess_workers.label: QC Preprocess Workers

read_noise.help: Detector read noise (electrons) in the error model; resolved DB-first (equipment-intrinsic), then FITS. WAVE-B removed its config.json fallback.
read_noise.label: Read Noise

save_lightcurve_png.help: Also write PNG pictures of the light curves and field map during the run (the app draws its own charts without them).
save_lightcurve_png.label: Save light-curve PNG files

sips_dao_fwhm_px.help: Star FWHM assumed by the star finder when the frame header carries no measured FWHM.
sips_dao_fwhm_px.label: Fallback FWHM

comp_isolation_fwhm.help: A candidate with a catalogue neighbour closer than this is treated as a blend and not used.
comp_isolation_fwhm.label: Comparison isolation

snr_min.help: Faint limit for targets, comparison and check stars: below this aperture SNR a star is not measured, and a frame where the target falls below it is not exported. 10 = 0.11 mag.
snr_min.label: Minimum SNR

sparse_trust_T_green.help: Check-star test statistic below which a sparse field is green.
sparse_trust_T_green.label: Sparse field green limit

sparse_trust_T_red.help: Check-star test statistic above which a sparse field is red.
sparse_trust_T_red.label: Sparse field red limit

sparse_trust_X2_RED.help: Excess variance of the check star above which a sparse field is red.
sparse_trust_X2_RED.label: Sparse field excess variance limit

tess_enabled.help: On: the night run checks TESS data of every new variability candidate and the report shows it. Off: TESS stays available by hand in the Variability tab.
tess_enabled.label: TESS check of new candidates

trust_flag_enabled.help: Write a trust flag (green, yellow, red) for every point into results and exports.
trust_flag_enabled.label: Trust flag

vsx_out_of_scope_types.help: VSX variability types that are not measured automatically (for example ROT). Exact type match, also with the ':' uncertainty mark; manually added targets are always measured. These stars stay excluded from the comparison stars.
vsx_out_of_scope_types.label: VSX types not measured

photon_transfer_ci_max_width_factor.help: The gain measured from the frames replaces the camera gain only when its confidence interval is at most this factor wide.
photon_transfer_ci_max_width_factor.label: Measured gain acceptance

psf_chi2_locus_nsigma.help: An ePSF fit is marked poor when its chi2 lies this far above the chi2-flux relation of the frame.
psf_chi2_locus_nsigma.label: ePSF fit quality limit

lc_high_err_nsigma.help: Flag a point whose error is this many robust sigmas above the typical error of that light curve.
lc_high_err_nsigma.label: High-error point flag

tess_contam_max.help: Largest light of neighbours in the TESS aperture (fraction of the star's own) for a reliable TESS period; TESS pixels are 21 arcsec.
tess_contam_max.label: TESS contamination limit
